GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is selected when the authenticated member wishes to view their own reservations using their server-validated session token.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query is about viewing the member's own reservations, use LibraryAgentMyReservationsAction.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only provide information about the authenticated member's reservations using the server-validated session token. You cannot access or modify reservation details for any other member.
